parsed.explanation: The dossier carries no trans-specific material, so thin-data extrapolation applies (rule 13). The structural signals are uniformly adverse: same-sex conduct criminalised with conflicting but real penalties (3 months–3 years up to life), regular prosecutions in government areas, death penalty under sharia in a southern region at judicial discretion, an insurgent-controlled zone enforcing sharia with death, and documented non-state killings of alleged homosexuals as recently as 2024. Impunity is the norm, no anti-discrimination protection exists, societal stigma is severe with zero public discussion, and recourse for an outed person is absent. A visibly gender-nonconforming visitor faces the same morality apparatus. Killings are scattered raw counts without denominators, and no near-certain execution sequence is documented for visitors, so this sits above the 0.05 tier — but organised armed-group targeting plus state-enabled capital exposure and imprisonment places it deep in Severe Risk.
